data.body: Epic plan review BLOCKED on one visible execution-verifiability gap: byte-identical no-overlay / 13-built-in parity had no epic-level deterministic command. Anthropic returned repeated HTTP 529 transport failures for advisory overlap-judge calls, which abstained; the core review still produced BLOCK. Remediation: added an epic Acceptance Criterion naming the exact shared parity test selector and registered DD-EPIC-PARITY via set-verify-commands. No force bypass used; re-review required before claim.
